title: Beautiful Chapel
text: Beautiful Chapel, great tour guide made it an unforgettable experience. Sadly we couldn’t visit the Madrasah since it was closed on Sundays.
author: Julio_S

title: Great tour of the Royal Chapel
text: We only had time for the Royal Chapel portion of this tour, but it was excellent. Our guide Cynthia provided so much information and was able to answer all of our questions in great detail. We learned a lot about the chapel, the royal family and the city of Granada
author: Traveler454717

title: Great guide and venue
text: Forgot her name, but the lady who showed us around was really good and had some great stories and good knowledge of all the history and important items. the tour was in english for people get confused when described as "Ingles", great use of time and must visit venue if in Granada.
author: Nick_Z

title: Very knowledgable tour guides
text:
Estella was a fantastic tour guide. She could answer all our questions about the history of Spain and the architecture of the town. 
I’m not sure why there is tapas deceived in the tour description - maybe your itinerary needs updating? We took an English tour on 11th April
author: DocSleepy247

title: Great tour with Estella (in Ingles (English) and highly recommend ~
text: We did the Ingles (English) tour with Estella.  She was amazing and knew every little detail. We got lucky and it was just me and my husband so we were able to ask questions and she knew all the answers.  I would highly recommend this tour. It was a bit stressful as we were driving in from Malaga with a 10:00 am time and we had to find parking and then get there to the meeting point.  We had less than 10 minutes to spare.  I'm so glad we got to pay our respects to Isabella and Ferdinand.  Beautiful cathedral. There are shops all around and in the corner of the square where you meet is the best
author: tammyjewel628

title: Granada an exceptional place
text:
The chapel is interesting, because the Catholic Monarchs are buried, plus there is a very beautiful exhibition of pictures.
The cathedral we only saw on the outside but it is immense and it is in a square not very big but with good Mood.
You can also go for tapas around in the bars and restaurants.
We went free.
author: juanac857

title: The best of the best
text: One of the best tours I have ever done (and I do in every city I see). Special mention to Javier, the best of the best. Doubtless book with him, great fun for both adults and children. Highly recommended
